scientific_integrity: Algebraic theorem and complete local Jacobian calculation; numerical checks are secondary and do not establish infinite-parameter claims.
scientific_limitations: Only the canonical full three-token repulsive normalized softmax model on the circle and 0<h<1.
Strict transverse stability classification; nonlinear critical bifurcations and global dynamics are not classified.
Originality remains subject to independent historical literature review.
title: Reentrant transverse stability of a three-token equilateral state under full repulsive softmax attention
